title: They purchase four and twenty ripe plums from a girl at the foot of Nelson’s pillar
html_source:
“Mr. Power’s choked laugh burst quietly in the carriage.
Nelson’s Pillar.
- Eight plums a penny! Eight for a penny!”

In Chapter 6, Hades, on the way to the cemetery.
